name: Namaiki Junjou Furyou Shoujo
original_name: なまいき純情不良少女
source:
When I was younger I was bullied by other classmates. I decided to become a teacher so I could protect the weak students from any bullying. 

There is a student that is constantly misbehaving, even calling her parents isn't helping.

"I want to take revenge on the people who bullied me"...
translation:
当我还小的时候，我被其他同学欺负过。我决定成为一名老师，这样我就可以保护弱势学生免受欺凌。

有一个学生总是行为不端，甚至打电话给她的父母也无济于事。

“我要向那些欺负我的人报仇”……
